name: AllinOne WordPress SEO Settings By SettiMize
author: SettiMize

sections.description:
SettiMize is a versatile WordPress plugin that enhances your WordPress admin experience by incorporating advanced custom settings, fields, and optimization features.

This powerful plugin streamlines your workflow and boosts productivity by adding several essential tools to your admin dashboard.

Key Features

  • Word Count: Display word counts directly in the post and page list views. This advanced setting lets you quickly assess content length, helping you maintain consistency and meet content standards without opening each post individually.
  • Featured Images: Display featured images in the post and page list views. This visual enhancement optimizes your WordPress admin by making it easier to identify content at a glance, improving overall usability and management efficiency.
  • Hide Titles: Enable or disable the display of post/page titles on the frontend. This feature is useful when you want to hide titles for specific types of pages or posts.
  • Post/Page Duplicator: Duplicate posts or pages with a single click. This feature makes it easier to create similar content without starting from scratch.
  • Plugin/Theme Downloader: Add download buttons for plugins and themes. This allows you to easily download themes and plugins from within your WordPress admin dashboard, streamlining the process.
  • Auto Image Alt Update: Automatically update image alt text and titles when uploading images to your media library. This ensures your images are SEO-optimized without manual intervention.
  • Enable Right Click: Enable or disable the right-click functionality on your site. This feature can be used to protect your content from being copied or to allow users to freely interact with the page.

By integrating these advanced custom settings and fields, SettiMize optimizes your WordPress admin experience, making it an indispensable tool for efficient site management.

SettiMize Plugin Settings

General Settings

  • Enable or disable various features for your site: Toggle various features from the plugin settings page.

Word Count

  • Enable word count display for posts and pages: Show the word count directly in the posts and pages list view in your WordPress admin. This helps you keep track of the content length without opening the individual posts/pages.

Hide Titles

  • Enable to hide the post/page title on the frontend: This option allows you to hide the titles of posts or pages on the frontend, useful for landing pages or when using custom layouts.

Enable Featured Image

  • Enable or disable the featured image column in the post/page list: This feature adds a column displaying the featured image for each post or page in the admin post/page list view, making it easier to identify posts visually.

Post/Page Duplicator

  • Enable or disable the post/page duplicator feature: This feature adds an option to duplicate posts or pages, allowing you to quickly create similar content. A “Duplicate” link appears in the posts/pages list.

Plugin/Theme Downloader

  • Enable or disable the download button for plugins and themes: With this setting, you can add download buttons for installed plugins and themes, allowing you to download them directly from your WordPress admin.

Auto Image Alt Update

  • Enable or disable the automatic update of image alt data (title, alt-text) on upload: This feature automatically updates image alt and title attributes when images are uploaded, improving your site’s SEO.

Enable Right Click

  • Enable or disable the right-click functionality on your site: This option controls whether users can right-click on your website. Disabling it can help protect your content from being copied but may interfere with user interaction on some websites.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. For more details, see the GNU General Public License.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the settimize folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the ‘SettiMize’ settings page under the ‘Settings’ menu to configure the plugin.
sections.faq:
How do I enable or disable features?

Go to the ‘SettiMize’ settings page under the ‘Settings’ menu. From there, you can toggle the features On/Off according to your preference.

Can I customize the settings further?

The plugin settings are designed to be straightforward. For any specific query, please get in touch with our support form.
